question: TX 12 is related to RS 23 in a certain way. In the same way, GW 2 is related to ER 13. To which of the given options is NR -5 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c28817482dab245ca34a9ed2c7d15bec309f9c5ed7d11cb8daa13bef502bdd09.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**TX 12 is related to RS 23**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42ad488c1234f477602d5df73b8706c045b0074c0b4df7312bae30e4eafeca0c.png] 

**GW 2 is related to ER 13**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83e5e6b01d592af09a96ba5666d11178e43069f995b70334c5f4ebeb0ac2ece8.png] 

**NR -5 is related to**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/161bf5a8e07d3e60459dd69f8bc632c304217e22c5ffcda9bba12446b6608f4f.png] 

NR -5 is related to **LM 6**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
